2–4s: Close-up. The rolled chicken is coated in flour, dipped into beaten egg, and evenly covered with breadcrumbs. Smooth lateral camera tracking follows her hands during the process.
4–6s: Macro close-up. The breaded chicken cordon bleu is carefully lowered into hot oil. Intense bubbling surrounds it as a crisp, golden crust begins to form. Camera remains locked in a detailed macro frame.
6–8s: Medium close-up. The perfectly fried cordon bleu is lifted out and sliced cleanly in half. Melted cheese stretches from the center, highlighting texture and doneness. Subtle dolly-in enhances the reveal.
8–10s: Wide-to-medium shot. The sliced cordon bleu is plated elegantly on a dining table. The cook sits, takes a bite, and reacts with a satisfied, content expression. Camera slowly pushes in to end on a warm, inviting note.
Style: Premium food commercial aesthetic, cinematic depth of field, warm natural kitchen lighting, realistic cooking physics, ultra-detailed food textures, smooth professional editing rhythm.
